goal: angle inputs in degrees with robust radian conversion
positive_oracle: Góc lưu bằng độ; đổi radian chính xác tới 8.9e-16; text radian chuyển tường minh.
negative_oracle: |deg| vượt MAX_ABS_DEGREES bị OutOfRange; radian không đọc lại được thành độ.
decision_note: Legacy angle handling lives inside the C context (angular_rad) and `core_angle.rs`. OM9 keeps degrees as the stored unit and makes the radian boundary explicit; no native call is needed.
method: Read the legacy `rust/` module named above and the target crate; the portable behaviour is re-implemented in safe Rust (AGENTS.md rust-first) without the legacy C ABI. No legacy code is copied verbatim.
